related_questions.question: How do employers determine how much tax to withhold?
related_questions.snippet: The amount of tax withheld from your pay depends on what you earn each pay period. It also depends on what information you gave your employer on Form W-4 when you started working. This information, like your filing status, can affect the tax rate used to calculate your withholding.

related_questions.question: How do I make sure my employer is withholding enough taxes?
related_questions.snippet: Ask to see the W4 filed with your employer and check your deductions. This is a form you are required to fill out and is the basis for their withholding, so it's good to know what's on there and how it affects you. If you want to more taken out in withholding so you owe less at tax time, lower this number.
